phases: Phase 1: Decision-record contract -- qor/scripts/adr_contract.py (vocabulary, parser, dialect-tolerant seal predicate), doctrine-decision-records.md, backfill three ADRs, three-column Tier 2 in BOTH docs/GOVERNANCE_INDEX.md and qor/templates/GOVERNANCE_INDEX.md, glossary and index registration

Phase 2: ADR status drift detector -- qor/scripts/adr_status_lint.py importing adr_contract, four finding kinds with terminal statuses exempt, correction of the same em-dash defect at governance_index.py:143, registration as a Check in status_json.default_registry, FEATURE_INDEX FX028
Phase 3: One machine-author predicate -- attribution.is_machine_author becomes the sole implementation; github_surface imports it; pr_citation_lint.is_exempt_actor delegates

limitations: The detector binds a decision record to a phase only through an explicit Phase field; a record without one yields adr-missing-phase rather than a guessed binding.

Staleness is judged against seal-class entries in docs/META_LEDGER.md. A phase that shipped without any seal-class entry produces a false adr-phase-unsealed for a record claiming Implemented; one such phase exists today (Phase 23). A known false positive, not a blind spot.
Superseded and Rejected are terminal states carrying no claim about seal status, so no drift rule applies in either seal state. A declared exemption, verified by test.
WARN-only in V1: the lint exits 1 on findings and the nightly ladder reports it, but no seal aborts on it.
non_goals: Deciding whether a decision record's content is correct.
Any change to how /qor-status behaves without an explicit flag.
Normalizing the ledger's historical label dialects; the predicate tolerates them, it does not rewrite them.
exclusions: qor/scripts/status_full.py and the /qor-status --full flag; deferred to Phase 259.
Pruning the 30 unmerged remote branches, the 24 unmerged local-only branches, and archive/session-2026-05-09.
Pruning the 46 fully-merged local-only branches; outside the gone-tracking set the operator authorized.
Tuning workspace_fragility_check's active_branch_count >= 10 threshold; Open Question 1.
Remediating GH #431 and GH #432, filed separately 2026-09-04.

open_questions: Whether workspace_fragility_check's active_branch_count >= 10 threshold is correctly tuned for this repository, given 33 live-upstream branches already exceed it.

feature_inventory_touches.test_descriptor: qor-logic scripts adr_status_lint exits 1 naming adr-status-stale for a record claiming Proposed after its phase sealed, and 0 when every record matches its seal state

ci_commands: python -m pytest tests/test_pr_citation_lint.py tests/test_github_surface.py tests/test_status_json.py tests/test_governance_index.py -v
